messages:
mason_sales: Heads-up — Greenline Capital wants a POC for BYO keys with a twist: they asked about a threshold-HSM option (2-of-3 custodians) and an automated rotation every 8h during the POC. Also want proof of attestation on each rotate. Can we support and what's the presales cost?

anya_sre: quick check — workload mostly signing (OIDC) or decrypt too? that changes perf.

mason_sales: mostly ECDSA signing (~ES256), occasional RSA decrypt for legacy. expected peak ~800 QPS, steady ~200. POC 36h with two forced failover windows.

ryan_security: we support threshold HSM via partner HSMs or on-prem with our orchestration. For 2-of-3 custody we can run a split-wrap flow; attestation bundles per rotate are available (FIPS 140-2 L3 on HSMs). For wrapped-only escrow we store only blobs encrypted under customer KEK. If Greenline insists on Redwood-held escrow plaintext, legal addendum required.

claire_custrep: pricing asks from them: one-time key import fee, per-1M ECDSA sign ops, threshold HSM surcharge, and any inter-region egress cost.

anya_sre: presales (non-binding):
- One-time import + ceremony: $1,100 per key
- ECDSA sign ops: $28 per 1M ops
- Threshold HSM orchestration surcharge: $35 per 1M ops (covers multi-custodian coordination + attestation packaging)
- Cross-region mirror surcharge: $12 per 1M ops
Note: RSA decrypts billed at $75 per 1M ops. Concurrency for ECDSA scales well; threshold ops add modest overhead to p95.

mason_sales: can you sketch a short POC runbook we can include? they asked for an 8h rotation test and two failover windows.

anya_sre: short runbook:
1) import sample key, validate 10k signs
2) baseline 0-200 QPS (30m)
3) ramp to 800 QPS (3h) with 2x 2k quick bursts for 10m
4) at 8h trigger automated rotation (threshold flow) and capture attestation bundle
5) at 16h simulate region outage (10m) to validate failover, repeat at 28h
6) final validation: re-sign 50k tokens and collect p50/p95/p99 and unwrap error rates

ryan_security: SQ items: get org contact for key ceremonies, legal contact for any escrow exceptions, and whether a third-party custodian is required. also confirm retention window for wrapped blobs (default 14d for POC).

claire_custrep: I'll request the contacts and whether they're okay with wrapped-only escrow. Also will ask if 8h is negotiable to 12h for prod.

ticket-bot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-POC-2482 - "Greenline Capital BYOK: threshold HSM + 8h rotate" - assignees: @mason_sales @anya_sre @ryan_security

mason_sales: Next steps: claire to collect contacts & escrow preference, anya to send perf caveats + minimal SRE checklist, ryan to draft SQ answers + sample attestation snippet. I'll compile and send to customer tomorrow. :thumbsup:
